prompt: Implement function solve(prices) returning the maximum profit from a single buy-sell transaction.

title: Maximum Subarray

prompt: Implement function solve(nums) returning the largest contiguous subarray sum.

title: 3Sum
description: Given an integer array nums, return all unique triplets [a, b, c] such that a + b + c == 0. The solution must not contain duplicate triplets.
prompt: Implement function solve(nums) returning all unique triplets that sum to zero.

testCases.description: Two valid triplets: [-1,-1,2] and [-1,0,1]. Order within triplets must be sorted.

title: Merge Intervals

prompt: Implement function solve(intervals) returning merged non-overlapping intervals.
